Guidance & outlook: Our total income increased by 4.1% to INR322.4 crores in quarter 1 FY27 on a year-on-year basis.
The company recorded a profit after tax of INR4.4 crores in this quarter as compared to a loss of INR1.4 crores, which occurred in the quarter 1 of FY26.
The yarn division recorded a revenue of INR96 crores in quarter 1 FY27 compared to INR110 crores in the corresponding quarter last year.
Growth & demand: Sales volume stood at 36 lakh kgs and the capacity utilization stood at 70% during the quarter.
The division delivered a revenue of INR147 crores, representing a healthy 25% year -on-year growth.
Sales volume increased by 18% year -on-year to 59 lakh meters and capacity utilization improved to 80% during the quarter.
Margins & costs: The EBITDA stood at INR29.5 crores during the quarter.
The sales volume stood at 8 lakh pieces, while capacity utilization was 69% during this quarter.
Right now if you get to the segment-wise margins, more or less, we expect the margins in the Fabric business to be about between 12% to 14% EBITDA and in the Garment business between, say, 8% to 10%.
Capex & expansion: I mean in general, we are looking at an expansion next year of about 20%, 25% in garment and an expansion of about 20%.
And then we are talking about '27 -'28, another expansion of 20% in o ur garment and Fabric business.

Last quarter, if you look at the number, our capacity utilization being so low, yet we managed to make money in the yarn business, even at a 70% capacity utilization, which is very difficult to do for any yarn company.
Balance sheet & cash: And your debt has climbed back to almost INR500 crores to fund it.
Risks & challenges: On a sequential basis, performance reflected the seasonally softer first quarter.

During this quarter, however, the geopolitical uncertainties with the West Asia crisis starting led to temporary export logistic constraints with the customer pickups in shipping being delayed, which resulted in the deferment of certain dispatches and had an impact on our revenue in this quarter.
Sir, I want to know, I know the quarter 1 is seasonally your weakest quarter, but the sequential drop was still sharp, like garment revenue down 28% and the yarn volumes down 21% versus quarter 4.
